event_summary: On a crowded nighttime city street, colored aerial light trails and circular bursts appear, expand, and fade above the roadway while haze builds and spectators hold up phones.
raw_event_description: The view begins with a dark sky over a broad urban street lined with tall buildings, streetlights, signs, and a dense crowd in the foreground. Initially no large bright burst is active in the sky. Small distant lights and streaks appear above the road, followed by white circular bursts on the right-center horizon area that expand and fade into scattered specks. A brighter sequence follows with vertical purple and white light trails rising from the distant street area and large red, magenta, purple, and white circular patterns forming higher in the sky. The largest bursts expand into rings or star-like radial patterns, then dim while lower bursts continue near the horizon. Haze becomes more visible along the street and between buildings. After the larger bursts fade, faint specks remain in the sky, then later smaller pink and white bursts appear and expand before dimming.

reasons: The crowd, street, buildings, streetlights, and signs are visible.
The distant sky area is dark and partially obscured by haze and building silhouettes.
No large active aerial burst is visible in the first frame.

evidence_bank.observation: A dense crowd fills the lower foreground of a nighttime city street.
Multiple bright rectangular handheld screens are visible above and among the crowd.
Tall buildings line both sides of the road.
A green sign with a U-turn arrow is visible on the right side of the frame.
The initial sky shows no large active circular light burst.
Small bright points and thin streaks appear in the right-center sky above the distant street.
A white circular radial burst forms in the right-center sky.
The white radial burst dims into many smaller specks.
A bright white flare appears low near the center-right above the distant road.
A red circular burst appears high in the center-right sky.
The red burst expands into a larger circular ring pattern.
Purple and white vertical light trails extend upward from the distant street area.
A large magenta ring remains high while lower purple and white bursts are visible beneath it.
A large white circular burst expands in the mid-upper center of the sky.
A smaller red burst appears above and to the right of the large white burst.
Bright purple and white bursts glow near the distant horizon area.
Haze becomes more visible along the lower street and in front of buildings.
Many faint specks remain in the sky after the larger bursts fade.
The sky darkens again with only scattered faint points and lingering haze.
A small pink burst appears high in the right-center sky.
A later white and pink circular burst expands above the distant street area.
The camera keeps a similar street-centered framing throughout the sequence.
